note: NPS campground in the North Unit of Theodore Roosevelt National Park, 5 mi in from the entrance, on a cottonwood and juniper flat beside the Little Missouri River; bison often walk through. About 30 miles of trails start nearby. Watford City, 20 mi north, is the nearest town for supplies and firewood. --Claude
summary: rec.gov catalog: 46 sites (37 drive-in nonelectric: 27 pull-throughs 30-57 ft, back-ins 20-33 ft; 9 walk-to tent), no hookups, $20 May-Sep / $10 otherwise (stored high 10 corrected to 20), year-round, seasonal water/flush/dump, no showers. All sites bookable year-round now: derived fcfs some_sites cleared, note's odd/even claim removed. Pin ~470 m east of the sites: move. Waterfront stays not waterfront (evidence distance wrong: western sites ~20-25 m from the channel behind a riparian tree band).
